Nawazuddin Siddiqui's 'Dr. Hassan' Teaser Released

The teaser for the upcoming film 'Dr. Hassan', starring Nawazuddin Siddiqui, has been released. Siddiqui will portray a doctor in the film, which is described as a crime-mystery. The teaser also features Dia Mirza, who was involved in a prank related to the film's promotion.
